Jeff Cuzzi, a planetary scientist at NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, Calif., has been named the winner of the 2010 Gerard P. Kuiper Prize, the most prestigious individual award in planetary sciences.
...
“In the 27-year history of the Kuiper Prize, the award has been won by three NASA Ames researchers: Jim Pollack (1989), Dale Cruikshank (2006), and Jeff Cuzzi (2010). No institution, within government or academia, has more Kuiper Prize winners,” said S. Pete Worden, director of NASA Ames.

# Gerard P. Kuiper Prize
Last updated December 11, 2025 • 1 min readFrom Wikipedia, The Free Encyclopedia
The **Gerard P. Kuiper Prize** is awarded annually by the Division for Planetary Sciences of the American Astronomical Society for outstanding lifetime achievement in the field of planetary science. The prize is named for Gerard P. Kuiper. [1]
